item.title: Waymo suspends driverless freeway rides across US after California ban
item.description: California authorities have declared self-driving cars an 'imminent hazard to public safety' after traffic incidents.

item.title: Australia issues sanctions targeting Israeli settlers
item.description: Australia has imposed sanctions on three Israeli individuals and four organisations for illegal settlement expansion.

item.title: Rubio rules out cyberattacks or links between tech outages
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said there is no evidence linking technical outages to each other or to cyberattacks.

item.title: Mary Peltola flips Alaska Senate seat in another Democratic win
item.description: The hard-fought contest is the last to be called for the US Senate and likely faces legal challenges.

item.title: Nvidia shoots down calls for Jensen Huang’s return amid strong earnings
item.description: Nvidia board chair says chip giant 'does not intend' to reinstate Huang as it projects revenues of $130bn in Q4.

item.title: Rare images of Indigenous group in Amazon highlight threats, advocates say
item.description: Illegal activities in the Amazon pose grave risks to uncontacted Indigenous groups like Brazil’s Awa,.

item.title: Hungary on the hunt for a football hero
item.description: Northern Ireland has secured a Nations League promotion, drawing with Hungary 1-1.

item.title: ICE agents shove and pepper-spray pregnant woman
item.description: An American woman was shoved to the ground and pepper-sprayed by ICE agents despite telling them she was pregnant.

item.title: What is Trump hoping to achieve at APEC meeting in China?
item.description: US president expected to meet with Chinese leader for third time this year; hold trilateral summit with Putin.

item.title: Prosecutors allege man ‘destroyed’ US military plane at Irish airport
item.description: Daithi O'Corrain, 48, has been charged with damaging a US military C-130 aircraft while it was parked overnight.

item.title: Man charged over ‘brutal attack’ on Somali-American in Minnesota
item.description: Rideshare driver Mohamed Yusuf is in a critical condition after he was allegedly assaulted by a passenger.

item.title: Protests as Jason Arday’s accuser speaks at Oxford University
item.description: Hundreds protested outside Oxford University as Nathan Cofnas, who accused Jason Arday of plagiarism, spoke at an event.

item.title: Board of Peace warns Gaza ceasefire faces imminent collapse without action
item.description: The US-led board has decried continued fighting in Gaza and delays in implementing the terms of a 2025 ceasefire deal.

item.title: Ecuadorian fishermen sue Trump administration over drone strike
item.description: Crew say their boat was attacked by drones launched from US-operated vessel as part of 'manifestly unlawful' campaign.

item.title: DR Congo’s rival peace efforts fail to halt violence in the east
item.description: Diplomatic efforts struggle to end fighting in eastern DRC as civilians continue to bear the cost of conflict.

item.title: Eisenkot ally elected Knesset speaker with Arab bloc’s backing
item.description: Israel’s parliament has elected Matan Kahana as the new speaker with support from Arab parties.

item.title: Top IRGC commander in Iraq for talks amid Kataib Hezbollah tensions
item.description: Head of Iran's IRGC Quds Force to attend meetings over alleged oil smuggling linked to pro-Iranian armed groups.

item.title: Forensic experts claim Epstein was strangled to death
item.description: A team of forensic scientists is challenging the ruling that convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein died by suicide.

item.title: Why China’s Shenzhen was chosen for APEC summit
item.description: Al Jazeera’s Katrina Yu explains why China’s Shenzhen was chosen for APEC summit.

item.title: Iran war live: Bahrain, Kuwait intercept attacks, Manama blames Iran
item.description: Bahrain slams 'criminal' Iranian attacks as Tehran says it targeted a US base in Kuwait.

item.title: Kuwait reports drone attacks as Iran, US trade attacks on Qeshm and Bahrain
item.description: Kuwait's military says its air defence was repelling drones as Iran and the US hit out at each other across the Gulf.

item.title: Israel parliament elects Gadi Eisenkot ally Matan Kahana as new speaker
item.description: Eisenkot’s bloc has pledged to undo some of Netanyahu’s most contentious domestic policies following Kahana’s election.

item.title: Top spy agency suffers network outage, the latest US technical failure
item.description: A series of unfortunate events has plagued the US. Al Jazeera’s Emma Withrow breaks down what we know.

item.title: Haitians protest in support of El Salvador’s anti-gang troop deployment
item.description: El Salvador's security minister has confirmed the troops will leave once kidnapped technicians are rescued.

item.title: Russian military plane crash in Siberia kills 19
item.description: Russia's Defence Ministry says preliminary findings for the crash point to equipment failure.
